evidence_items.locator: Opening announcement; sections 2, Details of the Transaction, and 4, Timeline
evidence_items.explanation: The disclosure identifies the preceding financing agreement and schedules its closings in April and December 2025. It also makes part of the financing conditional on restructuring, so conditions attached to the later round cannot automatically be treated as newly harsh terms.

evidence_items.explanation: The article presents investor concerns alongside continued consumer leadership and the CFO's account that the March fundraising attracted excess demand and finished unusually quickly. This is material counterevidence to a simple deterioration-and-funding-distress narrative, but the April observations and company account do not establish a controlled comparison with the prior round.
